subject: Creating a Makevars file to suppress compiler warnings slows down compilation

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Creating a Makevars file to suppress compiler warnings slows down compilation
parts:
Hi all,

following the instructions on http://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html, I got rid of the warnining being printed out after each compilation.

However, this drastically increases compilation time on Win 10, Rtools 3.3 and R 3.3.1.

Since there was no previous Makevars file in ~/.R/, I created one which looks as follows:

CXXFLAGS = -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-local-typedefs

My question is what do I have to add to the Makevars file to get back to normal compilation speed.

Many thanks in advance!

Paul

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Creating a Makevars file to suppress compiler warnings slows down compilation
parts:
On Wednesday, November 2, 2016 at 7:38:51 AM UTC-4, Paul Buerkner wrote:
My question is what do I have to add to the Makevars file to get back to normal compilation speed.

It may depend on what you had in the default configuration for your computer that is no longer being used. I would start by adding -g0 to CXXFLAGS to avoid generating debug information. If you do verbose = TRUE in the `stan_model` step without your customized Makevars file, you can see what is being passed.

Ben
